title: Real-time Data Synchronization
definition: In complex applications like Figma or Google Docs, real-time sync requires Operational Transformation (OT) or Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) to handle conflicts when multiple users edit the exact same element simultaneously.
simpleExplanation: If you and your friend both try to delete the same word in Google Docs at the exact same millisecond, algorithms (CRDTs) run complex math to ensure both screens end up looking the exact same without crashing.

answers.question: What is the main tradeoff of Real-time Sync?
answers.answer: Usually a tradeoff between Server CPU usage, TTFB (Time to First Byte), and Client CPU usage.
